_description: Recommended server parameters per model family. Used by GUI 'Apply Preset' button.

_format.pattern: Regex pattern matched against model filename (case-insensitive)
_format.name: Display name for the preset
_format.no_mmap: Optional: add --no-mmap for CPU fallback or residency-sensitive routes
_format.extra_args: Optional extra llama-server arguments applied into the Extra Arguments box
_format.disable_thinking: If true, GUI adds chat-template kwargs to disable thinking mode

presets.name: Qwen3.6-27B-Q3_K_S (Vulkan active 12k cold)
presets.notes: E257 Vulkan dense 27B cold lane: ctx=12288, q4_0 KV, b7168/ub1024, FlashAttention, thinking ON, spec off. Confirmed 7.0319 TPS r3 on triage_diff vs 6.6895 TPS for b6144/ub2048; prompt eval 999.22 tok/s.

presets.name: AutoTune 32k+ Qwen3.6-27B-Q3_K_S.gguf
presets.notes: Auto-generated by agent_workload_bench.py autotune for large context (>= 32768). spec=none

presets.name: Qwen3.6-27B-Q3_K_S (RX 9070 XT active 12k)
presets.notes: E257 active Vulkan 12k preset: q4_0 KV, b7168/ub1024, thinking ON, spec off. This is the current dense Qwen3.6-27B Vulkan cold profile; keep ngram off for cold-first comparisons.

presets.name: AutoTune 32k+ Qwen3.6-27B-Q3_K_S_mtp.gguf
presets.notes: Auto-generated by agent_workload_bench.py autotune for large context (>= 32768). spec=none

presets.name: Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_S (RX 9070 XT speed)
presets.notes: RX 9070 XT 16GB active Q4 speed preset: ctx=12288, b4096/ub1024, q4_0 KV, thinking ON, full offload. If VRAM is busy and startup fails, close other GPU apps or remove -fit off.

presets.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ3_XXS (RX 9070 XT cold 12k)
presets.notes: Measured cold/no-reuse local profile: ctx=12288, b6144/ub2048, q4_0 KV, thinking ON, spec off. E255 r3 reached 22.14 TPS aggregate on triage_diff. This is the practical cold >10 TPS A3B profile, separate from the dense 27B-Q3 kernel target.

presets.name: AutoTune 32k+ Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ3_XXS.gguf
presets.notes: Auto-generated by agent_workload_bench.py autotune for large context (>= 65536). spec=ngram-mod

presets.name: Qwen3.6-27B-Q3_K_S (12k prefill speed)
presets.notes: 2026-05-19 active 12k prompt-heavy preset: b4096/ub1024, f16 KV, FlashAttention, thinking ON, no speculative decoding. Vulkan wm32-wn32 reached 1230.73 prompt tok/s over 3 runs; ROCm f16 control reached 1194.22 prompt tok/s. Requires a clean 16GB VRAM budget; switch KV to q4_0 if memory is tight.

presets.name: AutoTune 32k+ Qwen3.5-9B-Q6_K.gguf
presets.notes: Auto-generated by agent_workload_bench.py autotune for large context (>= 32768). spec=ngram-mod

presets.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B (Pure Transformer MoE, 3.3B active)
presets.notes: Pure Transformer MoE 30.5B/3.3B active, 128 experts x 8. NO DeltaNet = fast prefill! Coding (thinking): temp=0.6, top_p=0.95, top_k=20. General (thinking): same. Non-thinking: temp=0.7, top_p=0.8. Q3_K_S=13.3GB fits 16GB VRAM. 32K native ctx, 131K with YaRN (--rope-scaling yarn --rope-scale 4 --yarn-orig-ctx 32768). /think and /no_think in prompt to toggle.

presets.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, 3B active)
presets.notes: MoE 35B/3B active. Coding (thinking): temp=0.6, top_p=0.95, presence=0. General (thinking): temp=1.0, top_p=0.95, presence=1.5. Non-thinking general: temp=0.7, top_p=0.8, presence=1.5. Agent/coding: ctx=16384. Long chat: ctx=131072.

presets.name: Qwen3.6-27B (Long Context ROCm tuned)
presets.notes: RX 9070 XT rocWMMA build. Full autotune (48 configs): BEST ctx=65536, b=4096, ub=128, q4_0 KV, spec=ngram-mod → 26.52 TPS. ub=128 is optimal; ub>=256 drops to ~20 TPS (kernel switches from VEC to TILE path).

presets.name: Qwen3.5-9B (Hybrid DeltaNet+Attention)
presets.notes: Hybrid architecture. Add to Extra Args: --cache-type-k bf16 --cache-type-v bf16. Thinking OFF by default, enable: --chat-template-kwargs {"enable_thinking":true}

presets.name: Qwen3.5-27B (Hybrid DeltaNet+Attention)
presets.notes: Hybrid architecture. Add to Extra Args: --cache-type-k bf16 --cache-type-v bf16. On 16GB VRAM: use Q4/IQ4 quant with tq3_0 KV cache.

presets.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B
presets.notes: Best coding model for code completion & generation. Context 32K is native max. FIM (fill-in-middle) supported.

presets.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-14B
presets.notes: Great coding model. Fits easily in 16GB VRAM with Q8 quant.

presets.name: Llama-3 70B
presets.notes: Large model. On 16GB: use IQ2-IQ3 quant, kv_cache q8_0 or q4_0, parallel=1. Supports up to 128K context but quality degrades above 32K.

presets.name: Llama-3 8B
presets.notes: Small efficient model. Fits fully in 16GB with Q8. Good for testing and light tasks.

presets.name: Mistral-7B
presets.notes: Fast 7B model. Fits easily in 16GB with Q8. Good general purpose.

presets.name: Mixtral-8x7B (MoE)
presets.notes: MoE model, ~12B active params. On 16GB: use IQ3-Q4 quant with kv_cache q8_0.

presets.name: Gemma-2 2B
presets.notes: Tiny model. Great for embedding or very light tasks.

presets.name: DeepSeek V3/R1 (MoE 671B)
presets.notes: Massive MoE model (671B/37B active). Even with aggressive quant needs 24GB+. On 16GB: use IQ1-IQ2 with q4_0 KV cache.

presets.name: Phi-4 (14B)
presets.notes: Compact but capable model from Microsoft. 16K native context.

presets.name: Embedding Model
presets.notes: Embedding model — use with --embedding flag. High parallelism for batch processing.
